name: code-aster
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: code-aster
  version: "18.1.6"
  sha256: 3f29c820559d9345c79fd85a6150445518b3d45ee40f0b9d1f1640d744cf03f2
  build: 0
  mpi_num: ${{ 100 if mpi == 'nompi' else 0 }}
  build_num: ${{ build|int + mpi_num }}
  mpi_prefix: ${{ mpi or 'nompi' }}
  # code-aster-tests (noarch) is built, and the full testcase set used, only in the nompi job of the lowest python
  tests_python: ${{ python_min }}
  is_tests_job: ${{ mpi == 'nompi' and (python | version_to_buildstring) == (tests_python | replace('.', '')) }}

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://gitlab.com/codeaster/src/-/archive/${{ version }}/src-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: ${{ sha256 }}
    patches:
      - patches/make_shared_use_env_FC_fallback.patch
      # numpy >= 2.4: trapz was removed, int() of a 1-element array raises;
      # medcoupling python 3.13 bindings: MEDFileFields iterator is not iterable
      - patches/numpy_py313_compat.patch
      # petsc >= 3.25 Fortran modules export interfaces that clash with aster_petsc_module.F90
      - patches/petsc_3_25_compat.patch
  # code_aster prerequisites sources (only homard is built from it); 18.0.2+ requires version 20251026
  # https://gitlab.com/codeaster-opensource-documentation/opensource-installation-development/-/blob/main/devel/changelog.md
  - url: https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/codeaster-opensource-documentation%2Fopensource-installation-development/packages/generic/codeaster-prerequisites/20251026/codeaster-prerequisites-20251026-oss.tar.gz
    sha256: e450bbbee0047cf17f6f9423400a7ac83fc633e6e62e596111825016e945e7df
    target_directory: codeaster-prerequisites/

build:
  number: ${{ build_num }}
  skip: osx or win or (python_impl == 'pypy')

outputs:
  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}-tests
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      number: ${{ build }}
      string: h${{ hash }}_${{ build }}
      script: copy_tests.sh
      noarch: generic
      # noarch output: build it in a single CI job only.
      # No variant.ignore_keys here: conda-smithy distributes CI jobs over the intersection of
      # every output's loop vars, so ignoring mpi/python would collapse the matrix into one job.
      skip: not (is_tests_job and linux and x86_64)
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - share/aster/tests/forma01a.export
            - share/aster/tests/zzzz121a.export

  - package:
      name: ${{ name }}
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      script:
        file: build.sh
        env:
          ASTER_BUILD_TESTS: ${{ env.get("ASTER_BUILD_TESTS", default="submit") }}
      string: py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}_${{ mpi_prefix }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_num }}
      prefix_detection:
        ignore_binary_files: true
      dynamic_linking:
        rpaths:
          - lib/
          - lib/aster/
          - if: mpi != "nompi"
            then: lib/petsc4py/lib
        missing_dso_allowlist:
          - if: linux
            then:
              - "*/libbibfor.so"
              - "*/libbibfor_ext.so"
              - "*/libbibc.so"
              - "*/libbibcxx.so"
              - "*/libAsterGC.so"
              - lib64/aster/libaster.so

    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
        - if: linux
          then: libgomp
        - cmake <4
        - setuptools
        - bison
        - flex
        - swig 4.2.1.*
        - waf ==2.1.5
        # 'mfront --obuild' (CREA_LIB_MFRONT) runs make in the testcases
        - make
        - if: "mpi != 'nompi'"
          then: ${{ mpi }}
      host:
        - python
        - numpy
        - libboost-devel
        - libblas >=3.9.0
        - liblapack >=3.9.0
        - libxml2-devel
        - openblas >=0.3.20
        - zlib
        - scotch
        - mfront
        - mgis
        - miss3d
        - metis
        - hdf5 >=1.14 *${{ mpi }}*
        - libmed * *${{ mpi }}*
        # ParaMEDMEM.CFEMDEC (code_aster.Coupling) requires medcoupling >= 9.16
        - medcoupling >=9.16 *${{ mpi }}*
        - scipy
        - mumps-include
        - if: (mpi == 'nompi') and not win
          then:
            - mumps-seq
        - if: (mpi != 'nompi') and not win
          then:
            - ${{ mpi }}
            - scalapack >=2.2.0,<3
            - mumps-mpi
            - parmetis
            - petsc
            - slepc
            - mpi4py
            - petsc4py
            - slepc4py
      run:
        - ${{ pin_compatible('mgis', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('mfront', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('miss3d', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('medcoupling', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('libmed', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('numpy', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - libopenblas
        - libxml2-devel
        - python
        - libxcrypt
        - scipy
        - if: (mpi != 'nompi') and not win
          then:
            - petsc4py
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('code-aster', upper_bound='x.x') }}

    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - code_aster
            - medcoupling
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - asterc_config.h
            - asterf_config.h
          files:
            exists:
              - share/aster/CTestTestfile.cmake
              - share/aster/run_aster_for_ctest
            # testcases are shipped by code-aster-tests
            not_exists:
              - share/aster/tests/**
      # This would run ALL sequential (currently passing 99%). Few failures due to missing xmgrace
      #- run_ctest --resutest=${{ env.get("OUTPUT_DIR", default="temp/seq") }}/${{ mpi }} -L submit ${{ '-L sequential' if mpi == 'nompi' else '' }} -LE need_data --timefactor=10.0 --only-failed-results --clean
      - if: is_tests_job
        then:
          # code-aster-tests is built in this job: run against the installed testcases (share/aster/tests)
          requirements:
            run:
              - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
              - cmake
              - ${{ name }}-tests ==${{ version }}
          script:
            - run_ctest -R 'forma01a|sslp114a|mumps05a|mumps01a|umat001a|zzzz121a' --resutest=${{ env.get("OUTPUT_DIR", default="temp/seq") }}/${{ mpi }} --clean
        else:
          # code-aster-tests is not available in the other jobs: only copy the few testcases needed
          files:
            source:
              - astest/forma01a.*
              - astest/sslp114a.*
              - astest/mumps05a.*
              - astest/mumps01a.*
              - astest/umat001a.*
              - astest/zzzz121a.*
          requirements:
            run:
              - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
              - cmake
          script:
            - run_ctest --testdir=astest -R 'forma01a|sslp114a|mumps05a|mumps01a|umat001a|zzzz121a' --resutest=${{ env.get("OUTPUT_DIR", default="temp/seq") }}/${{ mpi }} --clean

about:
  license: GPL-3.0-only AND CECILL-C AND Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-only
  license_file:
    - dep-licenses/
  summary: "Code_Aster : a finite element solver"
  description: |
    Code_Aster offers a full range of multiphysical analysis and modelling methods that go well beyond the standard functions of a thermomechanical calculation code: from seismic analysis to porous media via acoustics, fatigue, stochastic dynamics, etc..
  homepage: https://www.code-aster.org
  repository: https://gitlab.com/codeaster/
  documentation: https://www.code-aster.org/V2/doc/default/en/index.php?man=commande

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Krande
    - ldallolio
